app.title: Odin Tip Jar
app.intro: Tip any Odin user straight from your internal balance — instant and fee-free. Deposit tokens once, share your jar link, and watch the tips roll in.
app.connectPrompt: Connect with Odin to deposit, tip and withdraw.

jar.heading: Your tip jar
jar.linkLabel: Share this link to receive tips
jar.title: {{name}}'s tip jar
jar.ownJar: This is your own tip jar — share the link to receive tips.
jar.connectToTip: Connect with Odin to leave a tip.
jar.unknownUser: Not a known Odin user — tips still go to this principal.

tip.heading: Send a tip
tip.noBalances: No internal balance to tip from. Deposit some tokens first.
tip.note: Tips move internal balance between users inside the canister — no Odin ledger transfer, no network fee.

feed.heading: Recent tips
feed.empty: No tips yet — be the first!

deposit.heading: Deposit
deposit.note: Note: <0>deposit</0> pulls the approved funds via <1>icrc2_transfer_from</1> and credits your balance in one call — the credit is backed by tokens the canister actually moved, so no trusted minter is required.

withdraw.heading: Withdraw
withdraw.feeNote: Network fee: ~{{sats}} sats in BTC. You approve BTC on withdraw so the canister can cover the Odin ledger transfer fee — no canister float needed.
withdraw.noBalances: No internal balances to withdraw. Deposit some tokens first.

errors.feeApprovalRejected: BTC fee approval cancelled or rejected.

errors.canisterUnavailableTip: Canister unavailable — reconnect to enable tipping.
